keys.insert: INSERT INTO api_keys (key_hash, label, monthly_quota, month_bucket, requests_used, created_at, clerk_user_id, scopes) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?, ?)
keys.active_for_clerk: SELECT * FROM api_keys WHERE clerk_user_id = ? AND disabled_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
keys.by_hash: SELECT * FROM api_keys WHERE key_hash = ? LIMIT 1
keys.revoke: UPDATE api_keys SET disabled_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND disabled_at IS NULL
keys.list: SELECT id, label, monthly_quota, month_bucket, requests_used, created_at, last_used_at, disabled_at, scopes FROM api_keys ORDER BY id DESC
log.insert: INSERT INTO request_log (key_id, ts, endpoint, status, latency_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
keys.bump_usage: UPDATE api_keys SET requests_used = CASE WHEN month_bucket = ? THEN requests_used + 1 ELSE 1 END, month_bucket = ?, last_used_at = ? WHERE id = ?
